description: Verify that TCP in SYN-SENT ignores a bare RST control message (RFC 793 §3.9 p67)
approach:
[Objective]
A bare RST in SYN-SENT (no ACK) cannot be authenticated against the SYN; could be a blind reset attack. RFC 793 §3.9 says ignore.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → DUT in SYN-SENT.
2. Tester → DUT: bare RST.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond.

[Pass condition]
No DUT response to the bare RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_dut_syn — active OPEN didn't produce SYN
• Fail_unexpected_response — DUT emitted reply to bare RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently ignored bare RST in SYN-SENT — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_syn: No DUT SYN to active OPEN
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_response: DUT emitted response to bare RST in SYN-SENT
